scope: Public Melbourne Cup 2026 news surfaced by web search and major racing publishers

items.title: Cup weights to be revealed live on Racing.com
items.detail: The Caulfield and Melbourne Cup weights will be revealed on Thursday, the next major step toward the 2026 Cups.

items.title: Hopewell Rock races into Melbourne Cup contention
items.detail: Wathnan Racing is preparing Hopewell Rock for Melbourne after his Ebor second. He is expected to enter Newmarket quarantine in around two weeks, with Zac Lloyd among the leading riding options.

items.title: Australian Bloodstock trio aim up at Cups
items.detail: Wine Dark Sea is in UK quarantine for a late-September Melbourne flight, while Prix Kergorlay winner Defiantly is set to enter quarantine with the Melbourne Cup his sole Australian target.

items.title: Melbourne Cup stocktake after Shockletz golden-ticket win
items.detail: Shockletz's Archer Stakes victory secured a ballot exemption and prompted a fresh Melbourne Cup market and contender stocktake.

items.title: Cup blow for King Pedro as spring hangs by a thread
items.detail: King Pedro has been laid low by an infection and will miss the Metropolitan, leaving his Melbourne Cup qualification path and spring campaign uncertain.

items.title: St Leger history-maker Saffie Osborne sets sights on Melbourne Cup
items.detail: Racing Post's Melbourne Cup coverage highlights the St Leger result and its implications for the Cup campaign.

items.title: Shockletz earns Melbourne Cup berth with Archer Stakes win
items.detail: Shockletz secured a Melbourne Cup ballot exemption with victory in the Group 3 Lexus Archer Stakes at Flemington.

items.title: Cup clues to emerge on two continents
items.detail: Racing.com identified the Archer, St Leger, Kilternan Stakes and Irish St Leger as pivotal races for a large group of Melbourne Cup nominees ahead of the handicap release.

items.title: Mullins has Melbourne Cup hopes for Doncaster Cup contender Winday
items.detail: Emmet Mullins said the Melbourne Cup was firmly in mind for Winday, who needed a strong Doncaster Cup performance and a ratings rise to strengthen his prospects of making the field.

items.title: American Melbourne Cup hopeful Tawny Port wins again
items.detail: Tawny Port won the Bowling Green Gold Cup Invitational Stakes at Kentucky Downs after already earning a Melbourne Cup golden ticket in the Belmont Gold Cup.

items.title: Constitution Hill's Melbourne Cup hopes end after Kempton
items.detail: Constitution Hill failed the first ballot clause when fourth in the September Stakes; connections subsequently confirmed Melbourne was off the agenda.

items.title: Five international Melbourne Cup entries to watch
items.detail: Racing.com profiled key international nominations including Defiantly, James J Braddock, Stinger Glass and Hopewell Rock ahead of the weights.

items.title: O'Briens dominate Melbourne Cup entries
items.detail: Aidan and Joseph O'Brien supplied 16 of the 101 Melbourne Cup nominations, part of a 23-strong international contingent.
